Australia.track_characteristics: Fast street circuit with mix of high-speed corners and tight chicanes. Bumpy surface requires balanced setup.
key_corners: Turn 1: Heavy braking zone, late apex
Turn 11-12 Chicane: Critical for lap time
Turn 13: Long right-hander, exit speed crucial
Australia.setup_philosophy: Medium-high downforce, softer suspension for bumps, stable rear for kerb riding
Australia.racing_tips: Kerb usage is key. Be aggressive on kerbs but watch for car instability. Turn 1 is main overtaking spot.

China.track_characteristics: Mix of very slow and very fast corners. Long back straight requires low drag. Technical first sector.
key_corners: Turn 1: Unique snail corner, multiple lines possible
Turn 6-7: Critical chicane before long straight
China.setup_philosophy: Compromise setup - medium-high wing for turns 1-6, then low drag for straight. Stable in slow-speed corners.
China.racing_tips: Turn 1 has multiple lines - outside line is faster but risky. Setup for Turn 1 performance as it makes or breaks lap. DRS crucial on back straight.

Japan.track_characteristics: High-speed flowing circuit with challenging corners. Figure-eight layout with elevation changes. Requires brave, committed driving.
key_corners: Turn 1: Fast sweeping right, crucial corner
Japan.setup_philosophy: High downforce for flowing corners, stable aero balance, responsive turn-in. Confidence-inspiring setup needed.
Japan.racing_tips: Rhythm is everything at Suzuka. Build confidence through Esses by nailing Turn 1. Commit to 130R - lift means time loss. Spoon exit determines chicane entry speed.

Bahrain.track_characteristics: Smooth desert circuit with heavy braking zones. Multiple layouts but GP layout most common. Abrasive surface causes tire wear.
key_corners: Turn 10: Tight right after fast section
Turn 13: Final corner onto start-finish straight
Bahrain.setup_philosophy: Medium downforce, strong brakes, manage tire temperatures. Setup for Turn 4 and Turn 10.
Bahrain.racing_tips: Turn 1 and Turn 4 are key overtaking spots. Manage tire temps - easy to overheat rears. Turn 10 entry critical for lap time. Run higher tire pressures than usual.

Saudi Arabia.track_characteristics: Ultra-fast street circuit with blind corners and walls everywhere. Second-fastest track on calendar. Very risky.
key_corners: Turn 27: Final blind corner onto massive straight
Saudi Arabia.setup_philosophy: Low-medium downforce for speed, stable aero, confidence in high-speed corners. Brake stability crucial.
Saudi Arabia.racing_tips: Learn the blind corners in practice - commit is key. Walls punish mistakes instantly. Focus on carrying minimum speed through corners rather than late braking. Qualify well - overtaking is suicidal.

Miami.track_characteristics: Purpose-built street circuit around stadium. Mix of fast straights and tight chicanes. Bumpy in places.
key_corners: Turn 1: Heavy braking zone after long straight
Turn 11: Tight hairpin in stadium section
Miami.setup_philosophy: Medium downforce, slightly soft suspension for bumps, stable in chicanes. Good traction out of slow corners.
Miami.racing_tips: Turn 1 is main overtaking spot. Stadium section is slow - don't overdrive. Beach chicane at Turn 17 requires precision. Watch for bumps in braking zones.

Imola.track_characteristics: Old-school circuit with fast flowing corners and limited runoff. Anti-clockwise layout. Very technical and unforgiving.
key_corners: Tosa Hairpin: Key corner for lap time
Imola.setup_philosophy: High downforce for flowing nature, stable rear end, precise front end. Car must be confidence-inspiring.
Imola.racing_tips: No mistakes allowed - gravel traps everywhere. Tosa hairpin exit determines speed through next sector. Qualifying critical as overtaking very difficult. Smooth driving essential.

Monaco.track_characteristics: Slowest and tightest circuit. Ultimate driver challenge. No room for error with barriers lining entire track. Low speeds, maximum downforce.
key_corners: Sainte Devote: First corner, overtaking spot
Monaco.setup_philosophy: Maximum downforce, very soft suspension, extreme steering lock, short gearing. Stability over speed.
Monaco.racing_tips: Qualifying is everything - race is a procession. Focus on clean lap, no mistakes. Any crash means retirement. Brake early, turn smooth, maximize kerb use. Don't push - survive and you'll score points.

Spain.track_characteristics: Well-balanced circuit with mix of all corner types. Smooth surface, good for testing. Requires all-round balanced car.
key_corners: Turn 3: Fast left into fast right
Turn 10: Final chicane onto main straight
Spain.setup_philosophy: Balanced setup, medium-high downforce, stable aero platform. No weak points needed.
Spain.racing_tips: All-round performance needed. Turn 3 is key for lap time - carry speed. Turn 9 exit determines straight-line speed. Turn 10 chicane can be overtaking spot. Tire management crucial in race.

Canada.track_characteristics: Semi-permanent street circuit with very long straights and heavy braking. Walls everywhere. Low downforce, strong brakes needed.
key_corners: Turn 1-2: Tight right-left after long straight
Canada.setup_philosophy: Minimum downforce, maximum straight-line speed, very strong brakes. Accept handling compromise for speed.
Canada.racing_tips: Straights are everything - run skinny wings. Brake incredibly hard for chicanes - brakes will be stressed. Watch for Safety Cars. Final chicane is main overtaking spot. Don't hit Wall of Champions.

Austria.track_characteristics: Short, simple layout but very fast. Only 10 corners. Lots of elevation changes. Aggressive kerb riding rewarded.
Austria.setup_philosophy: Low-medium downforce, soft suspension for kerbs, good traction. Prioritize Turn 3 and 4 speed.
Austria.racing_tips: Very overtaking-friendly - Turn 1 and Turn 3 are DRS zones. Be aggressive on kerbs - purple sausage kerbs give time. Turn 3 determines entire lap. Track limits enforced strictly.

Silverstone.track_characteristics: Historic high-speed circuit. Many fast sweeping corners require aerodynamic stability. Flowing and fast.
key_corners: Club: Final corner onto Wellington Straight
Silverstone.setup_philosophy: High downforce for fast corners, very stable aero balance, confidence-inspiring. Mechanical grip less critical than aero.
Silverstone.racing_tips: Maggots-Becketts is where lap is won or lost - commit fully. Copse must be flat in qualifying. Stowe is overtaking spot. Weather changes quickly - be ready. High-speed corners are physically demanding.

Belgium Spa.track_characteristics: Legendary high-speed circuit with massive elevation changes. Eau Rouge/Raidillon is iconic. Weather unpredictable. Longest lap on calendar.
key_corners: Les Combes: Chicane at top of hill
Bus Stop Chicane: Final overtaking spot
Belgium Spa.setup_philosophy: Low downforce for Kemmel Straight speed, but enough for fast corners. Balance is crucial. Compromise setup.
Belgium Spa.racing_tips: Eau Rouge flat is the goal - setup determines if possible. Weather micromanagement - can rain at one corner and be dry elsewhere. Kemmel Straight is key overtaking zone. Don't overdrive Pouhon. Qualify well - gaps get large.

Hungary.track_characteristics: Tight and twisty circuit, often called 'Monaco without walls'. Very difficult to overtake. Requires maximum downforce and mechanical grip.
key_corners: Turn 1: Downhill right-hander, only overtaking spot
Hungary.setup_philosophy: Maximum downforce, soft suspension, extreme rotation. Qualifying setup critical. Sacrifice straight-line speed.
Hungary.racing_tips: Qualify as high as possible - overtaking nearly impossible. Turn 1 is basically only passing spot. Hot temperatures stress tires and driver. Setup for slow corners. Strategy is more important than speed in race.

Netherlands.track_characteristics: Old-school seaside circuit with banked corners. Narrow track, limited overtaking. Fast and flowing with elevation changes.
key_corners: Turn 1: Tarzan corner, main overtaking spot
Turn 10-11-12: Arie Luyendyk chicane, very fast
Turn 13-14: Banked final corner, full throttle
Netherlands.setup_philosophy: High downforce for banked corners, stable aero platform. Setup for Turn 3 banking and final corner.
Netherlands.racing_tips: Banked corners are unique - take higher line for more speed. Turn 1 only real overtaking spot. Qualify well. Track is narrow - passing nearly impossible. Commit to banked Turn 14 - full throttle rewarded.

Monza.track_characteristics: Fastest track on calendar. Temple of Speed. Very low downforce needed for long straights. Requires slipstreaming in qualifying.
key_corners: Turn 1: First Chicane, heavy braking after slipstream
Parabolica: Long final corner onto start-finish
Monza.setup_philosophy: Minimum downforce, lowest drag possible. Accept poor handling for straight-line speed. Strong brakes essential.
Monza.racing_tips: Slipstream is everything - tow in qualifying crucial. Run absolute minimum wing - 'Monza wings'. Brakes will be stressed from high-speed braking. Parabolica exit determines start-finish speed. Lots of overtaking opportunities.

Baku.track_characteristics: Extreme street circuit with narrowest section on calendar and longest straight. Castle section is ultra-tight, then opens to 300+ km/h straight. Walls everywhere.
Baku.setup_philosophy: Extreme compromise - low wing for straight, but need downforce for castle section. Monaco-spec corners with Monza-spec straights.
Baku.racing_tips: Two completely different parts of track. Castle section requires precision - any mistake means wall. Straight allows huge slipstream overtakes. Safety Car very likely. Qualify well but race is unpredictable. Be patient.

Singapore.track_characteristics: Night race under lights. Longest race of the year (2hr limit often hit). Bumpy street circuit, very hot and humid. Extremely physically demanding.
Singapore.setup_philosophy: Maximum downforce, very soft suspension for bumps, strong brakes. Prioritize mechanical grip and stability. Physical endurance setup.
Singapore.racing_tips: Physically hardest race - hydration critical. Bumps everywhere - smooth driving essential. Safety Car very common. Qualify well - overtaking difficult. Pace yourself - it's a marathon. Wall is always close.

COTA.track_characteristics: Modern purpose-built circuit with best corners from famous tracks. Turn 1 uphill is spectacular. Bumpy in places. Good mix of corner types.
key_corners: Turn 19-20: Final corners onto back straight
COTA.setup_philosophy: High downforce for esses, manage bumps with slightly soft suspension. Balance for all corner types. Stable platform needed.
COTA.racing_tips: Turn 1 is unique - uphill blind apex needs commitment. Esses (3-6) are lap-time critical, flow is key. Bumps can unsettle car badly - be smooth. Turn 11 and Turn 12 are overtaking zones. Back straight allows DRS passes.

Mexican.track_characteristics: High altitude (2,200m) means thin air and low downforce effect. Stadium section is unique. Long straight, tight corners. Altitude affects engines and brakes.
key_corners: Turn 1: Sharp right after long straight
Mexican.setup_philosophy: Run more wing than normal (altitude reduces downforce). Setup for slow-speed corners in stadium. Brake cooling critical.
Mexican.racing_tips: Altitude makes brakes overheat easily - brake early. Run more wing than you think. Turn 1 is huge overtaking spot after long straight. Stadium section is tight and slow - don't overdrive. Engine power reduced by altitude.

Brazil.track_characteristics: Anti-clockwise circuit with elevation changes and passionate crowd. Often wet race. Technical and challenging. Bumpy in places.
key_corners: Turn 1: Tight right-hander, main overtaking spot
Turn 12 (Junção): Blind right uphill onto start-finish
Brazil.setup_philosophy: Medium-high downforce, setup for elevation changes, soft suspension for bumps. Rain setup often needed.
Brazil.racing_tips: Weather unpredictable - rain common. Turn 1 is massive overtaking zone. Senna S needs commitment. Elevation makes car difficult to read. Anti-clockwise means unusual forces on driver. Passionate crowd creates incredible atmosphere.

Las Vegas.track_characteristics: Night race on Las Vegas Strip. Ultra-fast with long straights and slow corners. Very cold temperatures (for F1). Low grip surface initially. Spectacular setting.
key_corners: Turn 1: Tight right after long straight
Turn 14: Final corner onto massive straight
Las Vegas.setup_philosophy: Low downforce for straights, setup for cold temperatures. Strong brakes. Accept poor slow-corner balance for straight speed.
Las Vegas.racing_tips: Cold temperatures make tire warm-up critical. Low grip surface early in weekend. Straight-line speed is everything. Turn 1 and Turn 3 are main overtaking spots. Qualify well but overtaking possible. Manage tire temperatures in cold.

Qatar.track_characteristics: Newest circuit on calendar (added 2021, night race 2023 onwards). Fast and flowing with long corners. Very physically demanding. Hot conditions.
key_corners: Turn 16: Final corner onto main straight
Qatar.setup_philosophy: Medium-high downforce for long corners, stable aero platform. Manage tire temperatures. Physical endurance setup.
Qatar.racing_tips: Long corners are physically exhausting. Manage tire temperatures carefully. Multiple racing lines available. Turn 1 is main overtaking spot. Hot conditions stress driver and car. Smooth driving essential for tire life. Night race adds difficulty.

Abu dhabi.track_characteristics: Twilight race under stunning setting. Mix of slow and fast corners. Unique hotel section. Final race of season so championship drama common.
key_corners: Turn 8-9: Hotel section, tight and technical
Turn 20-21: Final chicane onto main straight
Abu dhabi.setup_philosophy: Balanced setup, medium downforce. Good in slow and fast corners. Stable in hotel section. All-round performance needed.
Abu dhabi.racing_tips: Turn 1 is main overtaking zone. Hotel section is unique - visibility tricky with day-to-night transition. Back straight allows DRS passes. Final chicane is technical. Championship pressure often factors in - mental game important.
